lore: A short book that knows throwable bricks, heads and other silly joys.
use: The Simple Fun Guide explains throwable bricks, heads and other silly joys. Craft it shapeless from a book and a crafting table.
secret: Its chapters unlock as the matching recipes land in your recipe book. Nothing is consumed.

lore: A snowball with a brick for a heart. Everyone knows it is a bad idea, which is the joke.
use: Craft four snowballs around one brick. Stacks to 16. Thrown, it deals 0 to 4 damage (default 2) with a cooldown of 10 ticks; both have their own server switch.
secret: It is mostly a cosmetic gag: it knocks back and hurts a little, and it breaks no blocks.

lore: {name}: a trophy that only a flash of lightning could earn.
use: Dropped by a pig killed by a charged creeper, at most one head per creeper. No recipe. Place it on the floor or a wall, wear it, or put it on a note block.
secret: Sneaking while wearing it gives a quiet, cosmetic greeting. Only a creeper charged by lightning counts.

lore: {name}: the same trophy, hung on a wall.
use: The wall version of the pig head. It has no item; placing the head on a wall creates it and breaking it drops the head.
secret: Heads only come from a charged creeper's explosion, one per blast.
